_about: Lines that came with playing it as a console, on a Raspberry Pi with a controller. The game reads this after en.json. A line whose key ends in _pad is the twin of the line without it, naming the controller's buttons instead of keys; with a controller in use it's shown instead. Buttons are named as on an Xbox pad, which is how an 8BitDo pad in X-input mode presents itself.

connect.title: CONNECT A CONTROLLER
connect.body: Plug one in, or switch it on. It's picked up straight away.

how_to_pad: steady aim; set up a gun
pause_pad: fire / steady aim, set up a gun
up advance, right cover, hold up charge

how_to.go_on_pad: A or B to go on

credits.back_pad: A or B to go back

pause.keys_pad: B  back        Y  quit to the briefing

debrief.keys_pad: d-pad and A  choose        B  title

hud.down_keys_pad: A  call for a medic      left stick  crawl      hold Y  let go

notice.out_of_ammo_pad: Out of ammunition. A on a crate, or on a fallen man's weapon

hints.dragging_pad: Dragging. A again to let go. Get him to a medic, or to cover.
hints.cutting_pad: Cutting. Keep still. A again to stop.
hints.set_up_gun_pad: LT to set the gun up first. It fires lying or kneeling, not from the hip.
hints.lead_orders_pad: Select picks a section. D-pad: left follow, down hold, up advance, right covering fire, hold up to charge, where you aim
hints.gun_set_up_pad: LT sets it up. It only fires set up.
hints.bleeding_pad: You are bleeding. Hold X to bandage yourself
hints.down_pad: You are down and bleeding. A calls for a medic, the left stick crawls. Hold Y to give up.
hints.on_fire_pad: You are on fire. Hold B to drop and roll.
hints.ranging_down_pad: Ranging round down. Y on the target to fire for effect.
hints.mortar_pad: Mortar! The flash marks it. Aim toward the mark and press Y to call the guns on it.

form.rechivii_hint_pad: Keep with the line. Click the right stick for the bayonet. Click the left to run, once the whistles go.
